dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study used 14 independently acquired datasets from 25 scan sites. Named/recognizable datasets include: ABIDE I (sites: CALTECH, CMU, LEUVEN_1, MAX_MUN, NYU, PITT, SBL, USM) for ASD; ABIDE II (sites: BNI, IU) for ASD; IMpACT-NL for ADHD; ASRB (sites: BRIS, MELB, PERT, SYDN) for SCZ; TOP15 for BP and SCZ; HCP (S900 release, n=150 unrelated subjects) for independent normative diffusion tractography. Additional datasets without standard catalog names include FEMS (First Episode Mania Study) for BP, MON (Monash Cohort) for HC, OCDPG for OCD, SPAINOCD for OCD, KANMDD for MDD, MITASD for ASD, RUSMDD for MDD, WASHASD for ASD, and YoDA for MDD. Because the study integrates >=10 distinct datasets, it qualifies as MULTI-DATASET.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "A final sample of 1294 cases and 1465 controls was obtained from a larger cohort drawn from 14 separate, independently acquired datasets and 25 scan sites following various exclusion criteria" ... Table 1 lists: IMpACT-NL, ABIDE I (CALTECH, CMU, LEUVEN_1, MAX_MUN, NYU, PITT, UK, SBL, USM), ABIDE II (BNI, IU), MITASD, WASHASD, Federation of European Microbiological Societies, TOP15, KANMDD, RUSMDD, YoDa, OCDPG, SPAINOCD, ASRB, MON ... "normative connectome estimated in an independent, healthy, unrelated cohort of 150 diffusion-weighted MRI scans (71 male, aged 21-35 years) from the S900 release of the Human Connectome Project (HCP150)"

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The study uses a single WMV normative model. HC from all clinical datasets plus the MON cohort were split into HCtrain (n=1196, ~90% from each site or all if site n<30) and HCtest (n=269). All clinical data (n=1294) served as test cases. Separately, 150 HCP subjects provided an independent normative diffusion tractography connectome for mapping the network context of WMV deviations.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Following stratification of the sample into training (HCtrain, n = 1196) and test (clinical data, n = 1294; HCtest, n = 269) subsets" ... "the training set (HCtrain) for the normative model was created by randomly selecting from each scanner site either 90% of controls or all controls if the sample size for that site was less than 30. The test set consisted of all clinical data (n = 1,294), as well as the remaining controls from each scan site (HCtest, n = 269)" ... "normative connectome estimated in an independent, healthy, unrelated cohort of 150 diffusion-weighted MRI scans"

model-1.model-name: WMV normative model (warped Bayesian linear regression)

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: A single voxelwise WMV normative model was trained on 1196 healthy controls (HCtrain) drawn from 25 scan sites. The overall HC sample comprised 1465 individuals (1196 training + 269 held-out test). An additional independent HCP150 cohort (n=150) was used solely for normative diffusion tractography and is not counted as part of the WMV normative model HC sample.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Table 1 reports HC age as median 27, SD 10.70, range 18-64 for the overall HC group (n=1465). These statistics are not broken down into HCtrain vs HCtest. The SD reported in Table 1 appears alongside the median (not the mean), so it cannot be directly used to compute a weighted mean. The age range for the training phase is inferred to be 18-64 since the overall sample was restricted to 18-64 years. A mean is not reported and cannot be reliably computed from the available data.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "All individuals were 18 to 64 years old" ... Table 1: "HC ... Age, Years, Median (SD) [Range] 27 (10.70) [18 - 64]"

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Table 1 reports HC n=1465 with 54.47% male for the overall HC sample. Computed: male_n = round(1465 * 0.5447) = 798, female_n = 1465 - 798 = 667, female_pct = 667/1465 = 45.5%. Sex breakdown is not reported separately for HCtrain (n=1196) vs HCtest (n=269).
